verdict.rationale: Superpowers keeps skills as harness-agnostic SKILL.md folders, shared verbatim across every harness, and porting never edits them (docs-13, docs-37). The same skills run across Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI, Cursor, OpenCode and others, with a cross-runtime `~/.agents/skills/` alias and multi-harness evals (docs-31, gh-19, docs-30). However, no evidence states conformance to the open Agent Skills specification, and each harness still needs its own install, bootstrap injector and tool mapping (gh-5, docs-28). Missing for 10: explicit statement of Agent Skills spec compliance, evidence the skill folder works unmodified without the per-harness bootstrap/tool-mapping layer, and independent corroboration of cross-vendor validity.
